scan_metadata.scan_type: PCI-DSS / RBI Compliance External Perimeter Audit
scan_metadata.target_scope: UPI Real-time Payment Switch & Open-Banking APIs
scan_metadata.compliance_framework: RBI Cyber Security Framework Annex I & PCI-DSS 4.0

findings.name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service (Zero-Day Exploited)
findings.threat_description: Attacker sends RST_STREAM frames repeatedly to exhaust web server memory and CPU, leading to complete outage of UPI processing.
findings.remediation: Apply rate-limiting patch for Envoy/Nginx and enable AWS WAF token protection.

findings.name: PHP-CGI Argument Injection Remote Code Execution
findings.threat_description: Locale character encoding flaw permits arbitrary command execution on partner integration endpoints.
findings.remediation: Upgrade PHP runtime to 8.2.20 / 8.3.8 immediately and verify API request sanitization rules.

findings.name: Terrapin SSH Protocol Prefix Truncation Vulnerability
findings.threat_description: Man-in-the-middle attacker can manipulate sequence numbers during handshake.
findings.remediation: Disable vulnerable ChaCha20-Poly1305 and CBC ciphers in sshd_config.
